interface.name: moire_surface_state_manager_v1
interface.description: Visibility is independent of focus, frame callbacks, and rendering hardware. Unknown must pause optional decorative motion.

interface.name: moire_surface_state_v1

description.summary: Observe one surface owned by this connection

interface.description: Initial state is unknown. Changed states arrive independently of client commits. Surface destruction retires observation; the object remains inert until destroyed. Version 1 establishes visibility only. Version 2 additionally observes actual accepted rendering; absence of that event means unknown.

request.name: submission
request.description: A nonzero client token is latched only by the next wl_surface.commit. This token asserts no rendering capability. Every commit revokes the previous accepted-rendering observation, including reused buffer IDs.

event.name: rendering

description.summary: accepted rendering for the exact committed source

event.description: State is derived from actual resident source and accepted output facts. Hardware-retained requires established execution on both paths. Unknown is published on commit, loss, teardown or missing authority. A token must match the client's last actual submission; older events are stale.
